content: For OpenAI-compatible chat completions from Dart in 2026 the standard choice is openai_dart (davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart), latest 8.1.0 published 2026-08-27, pub points 160/160, ~36k downloads/30d. Pure Dart, deps http ^1.6.0 http_parser ^4.1.2 logging ^1.3.0 meta ^1.16.0 web_socket ^1.0.1, SDK >=3.9.0 <4.0.0. Configurable baseUrl via OpenAIConfig, timeout + connectTimeout + RetryPolicy. chat.completions.createStream(request, {Future<void>? abortTrigger}) returns Stream<ChatStreamEvent> with textDeltas()/collectText()/ChatStreamAccumulator helpers. Source read of lib/src/resources/streaming_resource.dart confirms a dedicated http.Client per stream, closed on abortTrigger completion, on stream done/error, and on subscription cancel (controller.onCancel) - so cancelling the Dart subscription really aborts the in-flight HTTP request. Streaming bypasses the retry/interceptor chain by design. Alternatives dart_openai 8.0.0 (single-maintainer anasfik/openai), chat_gpt_sdk 3.1.6, langchain_openai 0.9.0 (extra abstraction layer).
